nodes.label: Workspace
nodes.rationale: The database lives inside the workspace folder so the whole thing can be moved to another folder, drive or machine and still work.

nodes.label: workspace_id
nodes.rationale: Generated once and never changes, so a workspace is still identified after it has been renamed or moved.

nodes.label: rusqlite
nodes.rationale: Uses the bundled feature so SQLite is compiled from source and no system SQLite is required (at the cost of a slower first build).

nodes.label: Themes
nodes.rationale: Components name semantic tokens (bg-app-panel, text-app-subtext), never palette colours, so every surface follows the active theme; System tracks the OS appearance live.

nodes.label: Tauri commands
nodes.rationale: The frontend never talks to SQLite; components never call invoke directly (every command is wrapped in src/services/ so a renamed command is a one-line change); commands are thin so the logic is testable without a running Tauri app.

nodes.label: AppState
nodes.rationale: Uses a single mutex that a scan holds for its duration so a query cannot observe a half-applied scan; the trade-off is that a very large or slow workspace blocks other commands while scanning.

nodes.label: CaseSyncService
nodes.rationale: The scan runs off the main thread on its own connection so it never blocks the frontend.

nodes.label: WAL mode
nodes.rationale: WAL mode lets the UI's queries proceed during the scan's writes; a busy_timeout covers the occasional collision.

nodes.label: name_is_custom
nodes.rationale: Without it, every rescan would silently undo a manual rename.

nodes.label: reveal_in_file_manager
nodes.rationale: Only filesystem/reveal.rs knows which OS it is on, so everything else stays platform-independent.

nodes.label: Migrations
nodes.rationale: Migrations are the authoritative schema — no hand-maintained schema.sql, which would drift from the migrations that actually run. Only ever append: editing a released migration leaves existing databases inconsistent.

nodes.label: folder_path
nodes.rationale: Stored relative to the workspace root on purpose: absolute paths would break the moment the workspace folder is moved (a supported operation); the absolute path is recomputed at read time.

nodes.label: name
nodes.rationale: Folder-derived until the user edits it by hand (then name_is_custom is set).

nodes.label: jurisdiction
nodes.rationale: Deliberately left empty by the scanner: trailing text is often a jurisdiction but nothing guarantees it, and a wrong guess is hard to spot later.
